response.overview: Bent on creating the perfect criminal empire, a Crime Lord documents his criminal history on a USB drive to learn from his mistakes. When a rebellion within the gang steals the device, the hitman "Jab" is hired to eliminate those responsible, forcing him to confront the fallout of a past mission while pursuing his obsession with committing the perfect kill.
response.tagline: WHAT IS PERFECTION? IS IT TRULY REACHABLE?
response.title: WITHOUT FAULT
